permissions.description: New hire records and their generated onboarding checklists

actions.description: Create a new hire and generate their checklist from the template
Every new hire's record and onboarding progress
New hires the caller is the hiring manager for

permissions.description: Onboarding tasks generated for a new hire, owned by IT, HR or Facilities

actions.description: Every onboarding task across every new hire
Mark the caller's own assigned task complete
Set or change any task's due date
Create, update or remove template tasks

groups.name: HRCoordinators
groups.description: HR staff who coordinate onboarding across departments

groups.name: ITStaff
groups.description: IT staff who complete IT onboarding tasks

groups.name: FacilitiesStaff
groups.description: Facilities staff who complete facilities onboarding tasks

groups.name: HiringManagers
groups.description: Managers who hire and oversee new hires' onboarding

roles.name: HRCoordinator
roles.description: Creates new hires, oversees onboarding across all departments, sets due dates and maintains the template.

roles.name: ITOnboardingStaff
roles.description: Completes IT onboarding tasks assigned to them.

roles.name: FacilitiesOnboardingStaff
roles.description: Completes Facilities onboarding tasks assigned to them.

roles.name: HiringManagerRole
roles.description: Views read-only onboarding progress for their own new hires.
